1:"""首轮注入的上下文（Spec 9.2；契约 core/context）。
2:
3:- L0 案件卡片：本方立场、当事人、争议焦点、关键事实、材料清单及状态；每条标可信度（✔律师确认 > 原文 > ⚠未确认）；
4:  标出 wiki 生成后新增或修改的材料。上限 6000 字。没有 wiki 时写"还没有生成 wiki"并列材料清单。
5:- L1 任务输入：任务单选用的前序成果，按窗口的 40%（按 token）装入；放不下的只列目录，AI 用 case_read_input 读。
6:"""
7:from __future__ import annotations
8:
9:from .. import contracts
10:from ..errors import ApiError
11:from ..llm import tokens
12:from . import gate, texts
13:
14:L0_MAX_CHARS = 6000
15:CARD_REL = "工作区/wiki/case.json"
16:MARK = {"lawyer_confirmed": "✔律师确认", "excerpt": "原文", "unconfirmed": "⚠未确认"}
17:STATUS = {"parsed": "已解析", "needs_ocr": "有页待识别", "ocr_running": "识别中", "partial": "部分识别",
18:          "failed": "无法处理", "source_deleted": "原件已删除"}
19:
20:
21:def load_card(root: str) -> dict | None:
22:    p = gate.resolve_internal(root, CARD_REL, op="context")
23:    if not p.is_file():
24:        return None
25:    try:
26:        data = contracts.read_json(p)
27:        contracts.validate("files/case_card.schema.json", "", data)
28:    except (ValueError, contracts.ContractError):
29:        raise ApiError("CASE_CARD_INVALID", "case_card_invalid") from None   # 契约 1.4（复核 P3-1）：原来是 INTERNAL
30:    return data
31:
32:
33:def changed_since_card(root: str, card: dict | None, index: dict) -> set[str]:
34:    """wiki 生成后新增或变化的材料编号。只算能进 wiki 的（texts.wiki_ready，和流水线挑材料同一个函数）：
35:    还没识别的扫描件不算新增，识别完成后才算。"""
36:    if card is None:
37:        return set()
38:    seen = {m["material_id"]: m["sha256"] for m in card["materials_at_generation"]}
39:    return {m["material_id"] for m in index["materials"]
40:            if seen.get(m["material_id"]) != m["sha256"] and texts.wiki_ready(root, m)}
41:
42:
43:def build_l0(root: str, index: dict, *, restricted: bool = False) -> str:
44:    if restricted:
45:        lines = [
46:            "# 本次请求材料范围",
47:            "",
48:            "本次提问按固定材料范围执行。案件卡片全文及无材料级版本证明的 wiki 内容未注入；",
49:            "以下只列本次请求固定的材料。",
50:            "",
51:            "## 材料清单",
52:        ]
53:        for m in index["materials"]:
54:            lines.append(f"- {m['name']}（{STATUS.get(m['status'], m['status'])}）")
55:        text = "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"
56:        if len(text) > L0_MAX_CHARS:
57:            tail = "\n…（本次材料清单过长，已截断）\n"
58:            text = text[:L0_MAX_CHARS - len(tail)] + tail
59:        return text
60:
61:    card = load_card(root)
62:    changed = changed_since_card(root, card, index)
63:    lines = ["# 案件卡片", ""]
64:    if card is None:
65:        lines += ["还没有生成 wiki。可以请律师先点\"生成案件 wiki\"；现在可用 case_search、case_read_material 直接查原文。", ""]
66:    else:
67:        stance = card["stance"]["text"] if card["stance"] else "（律师尚未填写）"
68:        lines += [f"本方立场：{stance}", ""]
69:        for title, key in (("当事人", "parties"), ("争议焦点", "issues"), ("关键事实", "key_facts")):
70:            lines.append(f"## {title}")
71:            for f in card[key]:
72:                cites = "".join(f["citations"])
73:                lines.append(f"- [{MARK[f['status']]}] {f['text']}{cites}")
74:            lines.append("")
75:    lines.append("## 材料清单")
76:    for m in index["materials"]:
77:        flag = "（wiki 生成后新增或修改）" if m["material_id"] in changed else ""
78:        lines.append(f"- {m['name']}（{STATUS.get(m['status'], m['status'])}）{flag}")
79:    text = "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"
80:    if len(text) > L0_MAX_CHARS:
81:        tail = "\n…（案件卡片过长，已截断；完整内容用 case_read_wiki 读）\n"
82:        text = text[:L0_MAX_CHARS - len(tail)] + tail
83:    return text
84:
85:
86:def build_l1(root: str, task: dict, read_input) -> dict:
87:    """read_input(root, ref) → 文本；选用后被改过的报 INPUT_CHANGED。"""
88:    if task.get("request_scope") is not None:
89:        text = (
90:            "本次提问按固定材料范围执行；前序成果没有可核验的同范围材料来源，"
91:            "因此未注入正文，也不能用 case_read_input 绕过范围。\n"
92:        )
93:        return {"text": text, "tokens": tokens.count(text), "truncated": bool(task["inputs"]), "toc": []}
94:
95:    budget = tokens.l1_budget(task["params"]["window"])
96:    blocks: list[tuple[dict, str, int]] = []
97:    for ref in task["inputs"]:
98:        text = read_input(root, ref)
99:        block = f"## 输入 {ref['index']}：{ref['title']}\n\n{text.rstrip()}\n"
100:        blocks.append((ref, block, tokens.count(block)))
101:
102:    def assemble(k: int) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]:
103:        """前 k 份放全文，其后的只列目录（保持顺序）。"""
104:        toc = [{"index": ref["index"], "title": ref["title"], "tokens": n} for ref, _, n in blocks[k:]]
105:        parts = [b for _, b, _ in blocks[:k]]
106:        if toc:
107:            parts.append("以下输入没有放进来，需要时用 case_read_input 按序号分段读取：\n"
108:                         + "\n".join(f"- 输入 {t['index']}：{t['title']}（约 {t['tokens']} token）" for t in toc)
109:                         + "\n")
110:        return "\n".join(parts), toc
111:
112:    k, used = 0, 0
113:    while k < len(blocks) and used + blocks[k][2] <= budget:
114:        used += blocks[k][2]
115:        k += 1
116:    text, toc = assemble(k)
117:    while k > 0 and tokens.count(text) > budget:  # 目录那几行也计入预算（P3-1）：放不下就再少放一份全文
118:        k -= 1
119:        text, toc = assemble(k)
120:    return {"text": text, "tokens": tokens.count(text) if text else 0, "truncated": bool(toc), "toc": toc}
121:
122:
123:def build(root: str, task: dict, index: dict, read_input) -> dict:
124:    if task["kind"] != "agent":
125:        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "not_agent_task")
126:    l0 = build_l0(root, index, restricted=task.get("request_scope") is not None)
127:    return {"l0": {"text": l0, "chars": len(l0)}, "l1": build_l1(root, task, read_input)}

1:"""Agent 插件调用的 /core/*（Spec 20.3；契约 contracts/core/）。
2:
3:五个命令：task/begin、context、tool、progress、task/end。返回体、令牌、错误码与 /api/* 相同（Spec 20.1）。
4:/core/tool 按工具契约校验 args，不合格 INVALID_ARGUMENT；开发和测试环境再按 $defs/result 校验返回。
5:"""
6:from __future__ import annotations
7:
8:from starlette.routing import Route
9:
10:from .. import tools
11:from ..case import context
12:from ..errors import ApiError
13:from .ui import _endpoint
14:
15:
16:def routes(st) -> list[Route]:
17:    def task_begin(d: dict) -> dict:
18:        return st.tasks.begin(d["session_id"], d["cwd"], d.get("request_id"))
19:
20:    def ctx(d: dict) -> dict:
21:        case_id, root, task = st.tasks.locate(d["task_id"])
22:        return context.build(root, task, st.tasks.index_for_task(task), st.tasks.read_input)
23:
24:    def tool(d: dict) -> dict:
25:        case_id, root, task = st.tasks.locate(d["task_id"])
26:        if task["state"] != "running":
27:            raise ApiError("TASK_NOT_FOUND", "task_not_running")
28:        tc = tools.ToolContext(root=root, case_id=case_id, task=task, tasks=st.tasks, materials=st.materials,
29:                               skills_dirs=tuple(st.config.skills_dirs))
30:        return tools.run(tc, d["tool"], d["args"], validate_result=st.config.validate_responses)
31:
32:    def progress(d: dict) -> dict:
33:        return st.tasks.progress(d["task_id"], d["text"], d["model_calls"], d["tool_calls"])
34:
35:    def task_end(d: dict) -> dict:
36:        return st.tasks.end(d["task_id"], d["reason"], d["model_calls"], d["tool_calls"], d["elapsed_s"])
37:
38:    E = lambda name, fn: _endpoint(st, name, fn, family="core")  # noqa: E731
39:    return [
40:        Route("/core/task/begin", E("task_begin", task_begin), methods=["POST"]),
41:        Route("/core/context", E("context", ctx), methods=["POST"]),
42:        Route("/core/tool", E("tool", tool), methods=["POST"]),
43:        Route("/core/progress", E("progress", progress), methods=["POST"]),
44:        Route("/core/task/end", E("task_end", task_end), methods=["POST"]),
45:    ]

14:def _page_lines(lines: list[str], start: int, limit: int) -> tuple[str, int, bool]:
15:    """从第 start 行起取整行，不超过 limit 字；返回 (文本, 结束行号, 是否还有)。"""
16:    out: list[str] = []
17:    size = 0
18:    end = start - 1
19:    for i in range(start - 1, len(lines)):
20:        add = len(lines[i]) + (1 if out else 0)
21:        if out and size + add > limit:
22:            break
23:        out.append(lines[i])
24:        size += add
25:        end = i + 1
26:    text = "\n".join(out)
27:    if len(text) > limit:
28:        tail = "\n…（本行过长，已截断）"
29:        text = text[:limit - len(tail)] + tail
30:    return text, end, end < len(lines)

680:    def coverage(self, root: str, case_id: str, task_id: str) -> dict:
681:        """按 reads.json 的实际读取记录计算，不采信模型自报（Spec 9.2）。只认当前版本（sha256）的读取。"""
682:        task = self._read(root, self.rel(task_id, "task.json"), "files/task.schema.json")
683:        index = self.index_for_task(task)
684:        reads = self._read(root, self.rel(task_id, "reads.json"), "files/reads.schema.json")["reads"]
685:        cov = {"total": 0, "fully_read": [], "partially_read": [], "not_read": [], "unreadable": []}
686:        for m in index["materials"]:
687:            if m["status"] == "source_deleted":
688:                continue
689:            cov["total"] += 1
690:            if m["status"] == "failed":
691:                cov["unreadable"].append({"name": m["name"], "reason": m["error"] or "无法处理"})
692:                continue
693:            try:
694:                units = texts.split_units(texts.read_text(root, m), m["unit"])
695:            except ApiError:
696:                cov["unreadable"].append({"name": m["name"], "reason": "材料文本不存在"})
697:                continue
698:            if units and all(u.text.strip() == texts.PENDING_OCR for u in units):
699:                # 整份都还没识别：读取工具会拒绝，不是"没有读"（律师反馈"10 份 10 份没读全"的成因，2026-10-07）
700:                cov["unreadable"].append({"name": m["name"], "reason": "还没识别，读不到文字，请先提交识别"})
701:                continue
702:            got: set[int] = set()
703:            for r in reads:
704:                if r["material_id"] == m["material_id"] and r["material_version"] == m["sha256"]:
705:                    got.update(range(r["from"], r["to"] + 1))
706:            total = texts.total_units(units)
707:            got &= set(range(1, total + 1))
708:            got -= {u.no for u in units if u.text.strip() == texts.PENDING_OCR}  # "本页需识别"的占位不算读过（P2-1）
709:            if total and len(got) >= total:
710:                cov["fully_read"].append(m["name"])
711:            elif got:
712:                cov["partially_read"].append({"name": m["name"], "read_units": len(got), "total_units": total})
713:            else:
714:                cov["not_read"].append(m["name"])
715:        return cov
